subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Know what a biography is and how it is organised.
Use biography phrases like 'was born' and 'at a young age'.
Plan a biography of a famous Omani person.

tf.s: A biography is a written account of someone's life.
tf.why: Yes, it tells the story of a real person's life.

tf.s: A biography is usually written in chronological order.
tf.why: Correct, events are told in the order they happened.

tf.s: 'Chronological order' means from the newest event to the oldest.
tf.why: It means in the order the events happened, from first to last.

tf.s: 'He was born in Muscat.' uses the past passive.
'She was knowing for her inventions.' is correct.
tf.why: The correct phrase is 'was known for'.

tf.s: 'At a young age' is a time phrase.
tf.why: Well done, it tells us when something happened.

tf.s: 'His greatest achievement was…' introduces the most important thing a person did.
tf.why: Yes, it shows their biggest success.

tf.s: Research is not needed before writing a biography.
tf.why: Research makes sure the information is accurate.

tf.s: A biography plan can include birth, childhood, achievements and importance.
tf.why: Correct, these are the main parts.

tf.s: 'In a young age, he loved reading.' is correct.

boxes.q: A written account of someone's life is…
boxes.why: A biography is about a real person's life.
First event first, last event last.
'Was known for' is the correct phrase.

boxes.q: ___ a young age, he loved reading.

o: to make sure the information is accurate

boxes.q: He will be ___ for his kindness.
boxes.why: 'Will be remembered for' is the phrase.

boxes.q: A businessperson who starts companies is…

o: a written account of someone's life
a list of facts about energy
mcq.why: Biographies tell a real person's life story.

mcq.q: How is a biography usually organised?
o: from the end to the start
mcq.why: Events follow the order they happened.

mcq.q: Which phrase introduces what a person will be remembered for?
mcq.why: This phrase sums up their importance.

mcq.q: What should a biography plan include?
mcq.why: These are the main stages of a life.

o: One year later, he moved to Muscat.
One year later, he move to Muscat.
One year later he moving to Muscat.
One later year, he moved to Muscat.
mcq.why: Use the past simple 'moved' after the time phrase.

mcq.q: You want to say the most important thing a person did. Which phrase do you use?
Why is chronological order useful in a biography?
o: It makes the events easy to follow.
mcq.why: Readers follow the life step by step.

mcq.q: Why is research needed before writing a biography?
o: To make sure the information is accurate.
mcq.why: A biography must contain true facts.

mcq.q: Which set of sentences is in the correct chronological order?
o: He was born in 1980. At a young age, he loved reading. Later, he became an entrepreneur.
He became an entrepreneur. He was born in 1980. At a young age, he loved reading.
At a young age, he loved reading. He became an entrepreneur. He was born in 1980.
He loved reading. He became an entrepreneur. He was born after that.
mcq.why: Birth, then childhood, then adult achievements.
